Q5910.reason: A recorded general-plan ban on building that binds later owners with notice is enforced in equity as an equitable servitude; common-law negative easements were limited to light, air, support, and stream flow.

Q5623.reason: The footage was of a real public protest and the anchorman's remarks were opinion on a matter of public concern, so the public-interest privilege and the First Amendment defeat the privacy claim.

Q5004.reason: The shifting executory interest to the sister's children who reach 25 can vest long after lives in being plus 21 years, so it is void under the common-law RAP and the friend holds fee simple absolute.
